text: 科博达公告，公司董事会于2026年11月12日收到董事长柯桂华先生《关于提议回购公司股份的函》。柯桂华基于对公司未来发展的信心和对公司价值的认可，提议公司使用自有或自筹资金通过上海证券交易所交易系统以集中竞价交易方式回购公司已发行的部分人民币普通股（A股）股票，回购股份拟用于员工股权激励/员工持股计划。回购资金总额不低于人民币1.5亿元（含），不超过人民币2.5亿元（含），回购价格不超过董事会通过回购股份决议前30个交易日公司股票交易均价的150%，具体以董事会审议通过的回购股份方案为准，回购期限为自公司董事会审议通过本次回购股份方案之日起6个月内。
text_en: Keboda announced that the company's board of directors received a letter from Chairman Ke Guihua on November 12, 2026, proposing a share repurchase. Based on confidence in the company's future development and recognition of the company's value, Ke Guihua proposed that the company use its own funds or self-raised funds to repurchase part of its issued RMB ordinary shares (A-shares) through the Shanghai Stock Exchange trading system by way of centralized bidding, with the repurchased shares intended for employee equity incentives/employee stock ownership plans. The total repurchase amount shall be no less than 150 million yuan (inclusive) and no more than 250 million yuan (inclusive), and the repurchase price shall not exceed 150% of the average trading price of the company's shares over the 30 trading days before the board resolution approving the repurchase. The specifics shall be subject to the repurchase plan approved by the board of directors, and the repurchase period shall be within 6 months from the date the board of directors approves the repurchase plan.
